scope: Five files only: portable explicit diagnostics JSON configuration loader, its focused tests, and desired-state C006/ADR001/TP001 amendments. No command/composition implementation, dependency admission implementation, SDK worker/receiver, native query, publication or ACK qualification.

actualValidation.limitations: Static imports; dynamic imports/type ownership/cycles still require semantic review.

independentControls: Depth12 reaches bounded decoder; depth13 refuses before decoder. Quoted/escaped structural characters do not consume depth.
20-digit signed and unsigned integers reach conversion; 21-digit and fractional/exponent tokens refuse before numeric conversion.
Unicode-decoded duplicate names and caller-authored origins refuse with fixed safe output-free error.
Real regular-file-to-FIFO replacement at os.open refuses using O_NONBLOCK/O_NOFOLLOW and closes acquired descriptor.
Same-size content overwrite with changed metadata refuses.
Read-only original BaseException survives read failure plus close OSError; cleanup-only KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit/GeneratorExit preserves exact identity.
Explicit17-leaf immutable origin map, secret wrapping, snapshot independence and no capture creation or ambient override.

correctedFindings.description: Adds byte-scanned JSON depth12 and <=20-digit parse_int before conversion; rejects all fraction tokens because typed schema permits none.
Formal failure-preservation wording now preserves the winning primary under declared first non-Exception precedence, matching error table and composition obligations.

documentationAssessment.ownership: One explicit loader and desired-state diagnostic composition owner; public ports only, caller owns run closure, native owner encloses every post-acquisition hook.
documentationAssessment.configuration: Exactly8 required JSON fields; ten bounded integer limits; explicit17-leaf origins; no discovery or merging; protected synthetic secret values only.
documentationAssessment.failurePolicy: Unavailable selected dependencies or initial capture refuse before business effects. Ordinary admitted remote startup loss preserves local capture; distinct diagnostics close cannot mutate native cleanup markers. First non-Exception cancellation wins ordinary error; existing non-Exception business cancellation retains identity.
documentationAssessment.retrieval: Desired installed retrieval releases one complete bounded JSON result including newline, no partial stdout or SDK/native calls.
documentationAssessment.formal: DIAG-F1/F2/F3/L1 remain precise reviewed invariants with scoped implementation correspondence and assumptions. Tests/static checks are not analyzer/model proof.

implementationRequirementsCarriedForward: Future composition must distinguish dependency/local admission refusal from a safely cleaned ordinary worker startup failure; catching every DiagnosticsError as degraded startup would be insufficient.
Acquire partial SDK resources under an explicit ownership stack before completed transfer; cleanup of partial construction and clean process termination must precede degraded startup continuation.
Close diagnostics without passing the business exception; apply the declared cancellation matrix outside the diagnostic owner. Ordinary diagnostic failures must not set business cleanup_failed.

Every diagnostic hook after native resource acquisition must remain within native owner cleanup. A diagnostic cancellation after completed report availability must not rewrite the completed authoritative business result.
Actual installed retrieval and ten-result native workflow evidence are separately required; this receipt does not substitute for either.
reviewerProbeCorrection: Initial independent test incorrectly counted all ten integer fields when expecting one target-token conversion. Corrected the assertion to count the exact oversized test token; initial failure log retained. This was a reviewer test-oracle error, not a source defect.
limitations: Synthetic local file and injected failure controls only; no real credential, network, SDK/provider, receiver, compiler, Spark or PostgreSQL execution.
File custody checks cover opened regular-file snapshot and named-path identity under reviewed cooperative filesystem assumptions; no hostile privileged writer or arbitrary filesystem-stall guarantee.
Other dirty files excluded. No production source/document edits or Git mutation performed by reviewer.
